Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 2493/2019

Dear Ms. Iyer,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 April 2019 about your dispute with Ramesh Mishra. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹44,40,000.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur
